assessments.name: Chapter 1
assessments.description: Identify, through curriculum mapping and professional practice, what theories/designs /case studies you will study. A written template will be given to you as a guide for this Chapter 1.

assessments.name: Progress Report
assessments.description: This includes an introduction to your topic plus most/some of the literature review component of your topic. Submit the first ~2500 words of your Final Report.
assessments.length: first ~2500 words of the Final Report

assessments.name: Final Report
assessments.description: This is a professional style report. You should use In-Design for graphic quality. Length is ~5,000- words (depending on the type of report and graphics/maps/images used).

assessments.name: Oral Exam
assessments.description: Each student is required to present their main findings from their Report to show your mastery of the topic. PDF of slides are submitted into Canvas.
